# Xenoi Biotech

Xenoi Biotech Pvt. Ltd. is a bioinformatics company based in Punjab, India. It provides NGS data analysis services (WGS, WES, RNA-seq, metagenomics, epigenomics) and runs 18 online 30-day bioinformatics workshops plus 4-12 week internships for life-science students.

## Services
- [NGS & Bioinformatics Services](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/services.html): End-to-end data analysis for RNA-Seq, ChIP-Seq, ATAC-Seq, metagenomics, and custom pipelines.
- [Genomics Services](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/genomics.html): Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and whole-exome sequencing (WES) variant calling, somatic mutation analysis, and structural variation.

## Training & Programmes
- [Workshops Hub](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/workshops.html): Directory of 18 specialized 30-day online NGS data analysis workshops.
- [Internships](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/internships.html): 4-week, 8-week, and 12-week virtual bioinformatics internships for undergraduate and postgraduate life-science students across India.
- [Career Navigator](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/career-navigator.html): Nine structured skill roadmaps for career transitions into bioinformatics and computational biology.
- [College Collaborations](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/collaboration.html): Institutional MoUs, faculty development programmes, student workshops, and curriculum enrichment.

### Workshops by Category
#### Transcriptomics
- [Reference-Guided RNA-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/rna-seq-reference.html): 30-day workshop on STAR alignment, featureCounts, and DESeq2 differential expression.
- [De Novo RNA-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/rna-seq-de-novo.html): Transcriptome assembly for non-model organisms using Trinity.
- [Single-Cell RNA-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/single-cell-rna-seq.html): Droplet-based scRNA-seq analysis using Seurat and cell-type marker identification.
- [Spatial Transcriptomics](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/spatial-transcriptomics.html): Spatially resolved gene expression and histological spot deconvolution.
- [lncRNA-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/lncrna-seq.html): Long non-coding RNA discovery, coding potential filtering, and cis-trans target prediction.
- [miRNA-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/mirna-seq.html): Small RNA sequencing, miRBase mapping, and novel miRNA prediction.
- [PSI-Seq / Alternative Splicing](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/psi-seq.html): Percent Spliced-In calculation and splice event quantification using rMATS.

#### Epigenomics
- [ATAC-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/atac-seq.html): Chromatin accessibility mapping, MACS3 peak calling, and transcription factor footprinting.
- [Single-Cell ATAC-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/single-cell-atac-seq.html): Single-cell chromatin accessibility, LSI dimensionality reduction, and motif enrichment.
- [ChIP-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/chip-seq.html): Transcription factor and histone modification peak analysis.
- [SNAP-ChIP](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/snap-chip.html): Quantitative spike-in normalized ChIP-seq using designer recombinant nucleosomes.
- [Methyl-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/methyl-seq.html): Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing (WGBS) and differentially methylated region (DMR) analysis.

#### Genomics
- [DNA-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/dna-seq.html): GATK Best Practices germline and somatic variant calling from FASTQ to annotated VCF.
- [RAD-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/rad-seq.html): Restriction site associated DNA sequencing and Stacks 2 population genomics.
- [Genome Assembly](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/genome-assembly.html): De novo short-read and long-read assembly, error polishing, and Hi-C scaffolding.

#### Metagenomics
- [Targeted 16S/ITS Metagenomics](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/targeted-metagenomics.html): Amplicon sequence variant (ASV) analysis with DADA2 and microbial ecology.
- [Shotgun Metagenomics](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/shotgun-metagenomics.html): Species-level taxonomic profiling with Kraken 2 and metabolic modeling with HUMAnN 3.

#### Microarray
- [Microarray Analysis in R](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/microarray.html): Differential gene expression analysis in R using RMA normalization and limma.

## Publications & Research
- [Publications & Research](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/publications.html): Journal articles and book chapters from the Xenoi Biotech team.

## Resources & Guides
- [Resources Hub](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/index.html): Directory of technical guides and algorithmic comparisons in computational genomics.
- [RNA-Seq Analysis Step-by-Step](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/rna-seq-analysis-step-by-step.html): Complete workflow from raw FASTQ to differential expression.
- [DESeq2 vs edgeR](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/deseq2-vs-edger.html): Statistical method comparison for RNA-Seq differential expression.
- [Single-Cell RNA-Seq Analysis Workflow](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/single-cell-rna-seq-analysis-workflow.html): End-to-end single-cell transcriptomics computational guide.
- [Spatial Transcriptomics Explained](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/spatial-transcriptomics-explained.html): Spatially resolved gene expression and histological spot deconvolution.
- [De Novo RNA-Seq Transcriptome Assembly](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/de-novo-rna-seq-transcriptome-assembly.html): Assembling transcriptomes for non-model organisms using Trinity.
- [lncRNA-Seq Analysis Explained](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/lncrna-seq-analysis-explained.html): Identification, coding potential filtering, and cis-trans target prediction.
- [Small RNA and MicroRNA-Seq Analysis](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/mirna-seq-analysis-explained.html): Detection, miRBase quantification, and novel miRNA prediction.
- [Alternative Splicing and PSI Analysis](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/alternative-splicing-psi-analysis.html): Quantifying Percent Spliced-In and splice junction regulation using rMATS.
- [ATAC-Seq vs ChIP-Seq](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/atac-seq-vs-chip-seq.html): Differences, trade-offs, and assay selection for epigenomic research.
- [Single-Cell ATAC-Seq Explained](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/single-cell-atac-seq-explained.html): From barcoded FASTQ to single-cell epigenomic landscapes.
- [SNAP-ChIP Spike-In Calibration](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/snap-chip-spike-in-calibration.html): Quantitative epigenomics using designer nucleosome internal standards.
- [DNA Methylation & WGBS Analysis](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/dna-methylation-methyl-seq-analysis.html): Bisulfite sequencing alignment, conversion quality, and DMR calling.
- [WGS vs WES](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/wgs-vs-wes.html): Technical, financial, and diagnostic comparison for genomic sequencing.
- [DNA-Seq Variant Calling Workflow](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/dna-seq-variant-calling-workflow.html): Best practices from FASTQ to clinically annotated VCF.
- [RAD-Seq Population Genomics](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/rad-seq-population-genomics.html): Restriction site associated DNA sequencing and Stacks 2 workflows.
- [De Novo Genome Assembly Guide](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/genome-assembly-short-vs-long-reads.html): Short reads vs long reads and Hi-C chromosome scaffolding.
- [16S vs Shotgun Metagenomics](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/16s-vs-shotgun-metagenomics.html): Choosing the right sequencing strategy for microbiome profiling.
- [Shotgun Metagenomics Workflow](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/shotgun-metagenomics-workflow.html): Taxonomic classification with Kraken 2 and metabolic pathway modeling with HUMAnN 3.
- [Microarray Differential Expression in R](https://www.xenoibiotech.com/resources/microarray-differential-expression-in-r.html): Step-by-step Bioconductor workflow using RMA and limma.
